'''Aegirocassis''' are [[extinct]] [[aquatic]] arthropods from the [[wikipedia:Ordovician|Ordovician]] era. They can be found in temperate and tropical oceans. Unlike standard fish, they cannot be butchered (but are live cookable), cannot feel pain when attacked, cannot be stunned, feel no fear and never sleep. They have [[Creature_token#EXTRAVISION|extravision]], allowing them to see even if they lose their eyes.

Some dwarves [[Preferences|like]] aegirocassis for their ''bold head sclerites''.
